thread:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — Partner asked for clarity on redistribution & marketplace listing terms. They want hosted + download options, and a joint announce window. Thoughts?
Jordan (legal): High level: hosted API + marketplace listing = fine. Download (redistribution) needs explicit permission and we need export/ML model provenance clauses.
Raj (product): Important to call out supported deployment modes in the catalog entry so customers know which SKUs are hosted vs downloadable.
Sam (solutions): From SI side, they want a single bundle that includes SI integration docs + prebuilt infra templates. Need to confirm redistribution rights for packaged weights.
Jordan (legal): If they grant redistribution, we need a redistribution addendum with:
```
- Permitted recipients (end-users vs resellers)
- Geoblocking clauses
- Attribution & takedown terms
- No-derivative or allowed-forks section
```
Maya (partnerships): Can we offer a split: hosted listing by default, downloadable SKU gated with review + addendum? That avoids surprise.
Clara (engineering): Tech note: downloadable weights often trigger quantization/exporting work. We should surface expected supported formats (pt, ggml, int8) in the onboarding checklist.
Raj (product): Also need to set a clear SLA/maintenance expectation per SKU. Hosted model has latency/uptime SLAs; downloadable obviously has none. Call that out on the partner page.
Jordan (legal): Agree. Also propose a short clause limiting our liability around downstream fine-tuning by third parties for downloadable SKUs.
Sam (solutions): For the joint announce: SI wants co-branded launch on marketplace + a technical webinar. We need embargo dates and a marketing asset checklist.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: @Jordan draft redistribution addendum + high-level bullets, @Clara add supported formats to onboarding doc, @Raj define SKU mapping (hosted vs download) and SLA blurbs, @Sam list SI assets + webinar date windows.
Jordan (legal): I'll draft 1-pager and share link by EOD. Will include a minimal export compliance checklist.
Clara (engineering): Adding format table to onboarding doc now: https://go.redwood/example/onboard-formats (draft).
Raj (product): I'll assemble SKU table and proposed pricing tiers for hosted vs downloadable.
Sam (solutions): I'll confirm webinar windows with the SI: prefer 2-week lead time after announcement.
Maya (partnerships): Great. For announce cadence, prefer soft-listing in marketplace 48h before public blog + webinar within 7 days. Flagging possible embargo conflicts if their legal needs review.
announce-bot: New doc created: partners/3169876543-redistribution-addendum-draft.md
Jordan (legal): Noted. If they require custom attribution language, we'll need legal sign-off and that may push the timeline.
Maya (partnerships): OK let's aim for a tentative cadence but mark timelines as dependent on legal review. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (solutions): One more ask from SI: can we provide a small test dataset for integration demos? Need confirmation from product/data.
Raj (product): We'll provide a sanitized demo set. I'll coordinate with data privacy folks.
Maya (partnerships): Solid. I'll follow up with partner to communicate this approach and set a follow-up meeting next week.
Jordan (legal): Draft link shared: https://go.redwood/legal/redistribution-addendum-draft (comments enabled).
Maya (partnerships): Perfect. Wrapping up — owners: Jordan (legal), Raj (product), Clara (eng), Sam (solutions). Follow-up meeting: next Tue 10am PT.
Clara (engineering): Added a note about quantization support impacting bundle size and download packaging.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks all, I'll ping meeting invite and include the draft addendum. :sparkles:
